entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5824"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 34</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.34.1-Ps.34.22">Psa 34:1-22</reference>. On the title compare <reference osisRef="1Sam.21.13">1Sa 21:13</reference>. Abimelech was the general name of the sovereign (<reference osisRef="Gen.20.2">Ge 20:2</reference>). After celebrating God's gracious dealings with him, the Psalmist exhorts others to make trial of His providential care, instructing them how to secure it. He then contrasts God's care of His people and His punitive providence towards the wicked.</title> <div sID="gen8865" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5824"/>1-4. Even in distress, which excites supplication, there is always matter for praising and thanking God (compare <reference osisRef="Eph.5.20">Ep 5:20</reference>; <reference osisRef="Phil.4.6">Php 4:6</reference>). <div eID="gen8865" type="x-p"/>
